Smart-Ride
Smart Car Sharing System2026

Find a nearby car on the map, book it and drive. Three services working together: a client app, an API server and a background worker.

  • Live map with Google Maps API and geolocation: the user's position and the distance to every car, in real time
  • Real-time availability: a booked car turns "taken" instantly for every user, without a refresh
  • REST API in C# and .NET Core with SQL Server: business logic, LINQ queries, dynamic pricing and automated emails
  • Seven-step sign-up, JWT authentication and authorization, and an admin panel for the fleet

Split-It
Shared Expenses with an AI Agent2026

Everyone logs what they paid, and the app works out who owes whom, with the fewest possible transfers.

  • LLM-based AI Agent with Tool Calling: "I paid 240 for a taxi" – and the expense is recorded, categorized and split automatically
  • Debt-settlement algorithm: 5 expenses and 4 participants – just 3 transfers instead of 14
  • Real-time updates: an expense added from a phone shows up for everyone instantly
  • Node.js, Express, MongoDB and Angular with TypeScript, following Clean Code and Separation of Concerns

AI · Computer Vision
ViroEngine
Medical Form Data Extraction Engine2026

2026 AI Open-Source Hackathon – Central Virology Laboratory Challenge (Ministry of Health, Sheba). Scanned, photographed and handwritten forms become verified spreadsheet rows.

  • Worked as part of a team on a system that extracts fields from scanned and handwritten forms into Excel
  • Local processing pipeline with OCR and ID-number validation, calling a vision model only for unclear fields – so sensitive data stays private
  • Every field gets a confidence level, and flagged cells go to a human-review interface that shows the original area of the form
  • Export of the verified data to Excel, CSV or JSON
PythonFastAPIReactOpenCVTesseractGemini API
GitHub

The engine's architecture: the core depends only on interfaces, and every external component – OCR, vision model, storage and export – plugs in through an adapter.

An empty, flagged field is better than a guess.
The project's leading metric isn't accuracy but the silent error – a wrong value the system didn't flag. When the engine isn't sure, it says so, explains why and shows exactly the area it read.

Browser Strategy Game2024–2025

Connect Four for two players, in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript – no libraries and no server.
